name: KY-034 seven-colour flash LED
not_buildable: It lights when an output pin powers it. It is an output part, and LearnLens sketches may only switch the board's own LEDs so far.
identification: Small black PCB with 3 angled header pins at one end and a clear 5 mm LED bent flat so that it points away from the board. The KY-005 infrared LED looks the same.

facts.statement: The LED cycles through its colours by itself while it is powered; voltage range 3.3 V to 5 V.
facts.source: Joy-IT SensorKit, KY-034, description and technical data
